topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 1131 project-authored contract(s) across 7 chain(s); 16 ERC4626 vaults, 215 ERC20 tokens, 7 ERC721 NFTs, 3 ERC1155 multi-tokens, 11 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 141 common project-authored base contract(s) (ownableupgradeable, contextupgradeable, routermodulebase). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
